name: Will-o'-Wisp

specialAbilities.name: Ephemeral
specialAbilities.description: The wisp can't wear or carry anything.

specialAbilities.name: Illumination
specialAbilities.description: The wisp sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.

specialAbilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
specialAbilities.description: The wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

specialAbilities.name: Consume Life
specialAbilities.description: Bonus Action. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, one living creature the wisp can see within 5 feet that has 0 Hit Points. Failure: The wisp regains 10 (3d6) Hit Points.

specialAbilities.name: Vanish
specialAbilities.description: Bonus Action. The wisp and its light have the Invisible condition until the wisp's Concentration ends on this effect, which ends early immediately after the wisp makes an attack roll or uses Consume Life.

actions.name: Shock
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) Lightning damage.
